title: 18891 - 18891/P2459/009305
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Faulty Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleris (G450/G451)
stepByStepSolution: Inspect Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleris (G450/G451) as per factory repair manual.
technicalNotes:
Depending on driving habits, soot can build up quickly in the DPF, thus requiring more frequent regenerations than normal.
With CBEA and CJAA engines, the factory documentation may show the wrong part location for the Exhaust Pressure Sensör Okuma Değerleri 1 (G450).  This sensor is in a foil pouch just behind the oil cap.
